questions.question: What event does Psalm 126 celebrate?
options: When the LORD struck down the firstborn of Egypt
When the LORD sent fire upon the altar
When the LORD gave David victory in battle
When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion
questions.answer: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion

questions.question: What promise does the psalm give about sowing in tears?
options: Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy
Those who sow in sorrow gather only thorns
Those who mourn will be left with empty hands
Those who weep now will only weep all the more in the end
questions.answer: Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy
